name: 1.1 Smart Loan Advisor - Data Ingestion with Eval Suite Hook

parameters.content:
## 📊 Step 1: Data Ingestion & Vectors
Fetches live CDR customer data, open-banking-mcp business loan rates, and RBA cash rate signals, then embeds and saves them to Qdrant.

## 🎓 Step 2: Automated Live Eval Suite
Triggered immediately after Qdrant finishes vector indexing. Consolidates the 20 indexed chunks into 1 event, executes golden queries against the RAG pipeline via `POST /api/eval`, and displays the live Ragas scorecard.
